title: AutoFix Agent Result
description: Structure stored in autofix.incident.agent_result (JSONB) once create-pr.sh has produced a Draft PR. This is the only durable record of the agent run's outcome -- no PR URL is persisted (branch_name + prNumber are sufficient to look the PR up again via `gh pr list --head`).

testsPassed.description: Always true when this object is written -- validate-diff.sh only allows create-pr.sh to run after an independent `./gradlew clean test` pass.

changedFiles.description: Number of files changed in the commit (production + test).

commitSha.description: The commit SHA pushed to the autofix/<JIRA-KEY> branch.

prNumber.description: GitHub Draft PR number. Combined with branch_name, this is enough to reconstruct the PR URL via `gh pr list --head <branch_name>` -- the URL itself is never stored.
